INSERT INTO users (
  id, 
  openId, 
  name, 
  email, 
  loginMethod, 
  lastSignedIn, 
  role, 
  userType,
  realName,
  phoneNumber,
  password,
  verificationStatus,
  verificationMethod,
  verifiedAt,
  createdAt,
  updatedAt
) VALUES (
  UUID(),
  'test_user_openid_123',
  'Test User',
  'testuser@example.com',
  'google',
  NOW(),
  'user',
  'student',
  'Test User',
  '010-1234-5678',
  'test_password_encoded',
  'pending',
  'none',
  NULL,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  lastSignedIn = NOW(),
  updatedAt = NOW();
